datasets.name: odsxx
datasets.sql:
/*select count(*) say,dat,inv_num, inv_date,debit,credit,
       trans_date, par1,par3, par4, par5,
       par6, par7, par8, par9, mebleg ,
       par13, par14, par15,debt,sum(aMMOUNT) ammount, odenis, RN from  (*/
select par11, p.dat,inv_num, inv_date,debit,credit,
       trans_date, par1,par3, par4, par5,
       par6, par7, par8, par9,  ROUND(par12,2)mebleg ,
       par13, par14, par15,P.debt,P.aMMOUNT,null odenis,null as yanacaq,1 as RN from provarch p,invoices i where (p.parentid=i.trans_id or  p.id=i.trans_id) and  vid_op=92
       and       p.dat between :begindat and :enddat
                 and kredit=:v_accid
      /* )a 
       group by dat,inv_num, inv_date,debit,credit,
       trans_date, par1,par3, par4, par5,
       par6, par7, par8, par9, mebleg ,
       par13, par14, par15,debt, odenis, RN*/
    
union all

select null as par11,p.dat,null as inv_num,null as inv_date,null as debit,null as credit,
      null as trans_date,null as par1,null as par3,null as par4,null as par5,
       null as par6,null as par7,null as par8,null as par9,0 as mebleg ,
      null as par13,null as par14,null as par15,P.debt,null aMMOUNT,p.ammount odenis,null as yanacaq ,2 as RN from provarch p, account a where p.debt=a.id
      
  and (debt  in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '531') or debt  in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '535'))
  and (kredit in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '22%')
      or kredit in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '192%'))
  and p.dat between :begindat and :enddat
  and p.debt=:v_accid


union all

select null as par11,p.dat,'Qeza' as inv_num,null as inv_date,null as debit,null as credit,
       null as trans_date,null as par1,null as par3,null as par4,null as par5,
       null as par6,null as par7,null as par8,null as par9,0 as mebleg ,
      null as par13,null as par14,null as par15,P.debt,null aMMOUNT,p.ammount odenis ,null as yanacaq,2 as RN from provarch p, account a where p.debt=a.id
      
  and (debt  in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '531') or debt  in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '535'))
  and kredit in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '721%')
    and p.vid_op<>93
  and p.dat between :begindat and :enddat
  and p.debt=:v_accid
  
  

  union all

select null as par11,p.dat,' ' as inv_num,null as inv_date,null as debit,null as credit,
       null as trans_date,null as par1,null as par3,null as par4,null as par5,
       null as par6,null as par7,null as par8,null as par9,0 as mebleg ,
      null as par13,null as par14,null as par15,P.debt,null aMMOUNT,null as odenis,p.ammount yanacaq,4 as RN from provarch p, account a where p.debt=a.id
   and p.vid_op=93
     and p.dat between :begindat and :enddat
  and p.KREDIT=:v_accid

  order by  RN, dat
 /* and debt   in (select id from account where bal_cn1 like '531')
  and kredit in (select id from account where bal_cn1 not like '22%')*/

datasets.name: DepozDset
datasets.sql:
select 
       cont.id,
       cont.contractno,
       av.val_name,
       dm_stored_programs.getcustomername(cont.customerid) as CustomerName,
       cont.opendate,
       cont.closedate,
       cont.amount,
       interest,      
       (select sum(facticaldebt) from dm_history_currstate where id#=cont.id) as facticaldebt ,
       (select sum(facticalinterestdebt) from dm_history_currstate where id#=cont.id) as facticalinterestdebt,
       (select ostat from tenostat where acc_id=acc.clientaccid) as ostat,
       (select type from dm_types where id=cont.contracttype)as contracttypename,
       cont.currency,
       cont.personaltype,
       cont.clienttype,
       cont.branchid,
       cont.contracttype,
       cont.customerid,
       cont.prolongationdate,
       cont.stopcalcdate,
       cont.sid# as usid,
       (select name from user$ where id=cont.sid#) username
from dm_active_contracts cont,
     dm_contract_accounts acc,
     avalute av
where acc.id# = cont.id and
      cont.currency = av.valute and
      cont.type# = 3 
    
     and cont.customerid=:CUSTID


order by :OrderField

       (select val_name from avalute where valute=p.val_acc)as val_name
  from 
lazytransaction p, account a,archost ar 
  where p.id=:trid and p.debt=a.id and p.debt=ar.acc_id and p.dat=:dat and ar.datdate=:dat

datasets.name: ods_cust_acc
datasets.sql:
select a.id, 
   c.firstname||'   ' ||c.patronymic||'   '||c.lastname as custname,a.val_acc,abs(ar.pok_ostat)pok_ostat,
   abs(ar.ostat) ostat, a.acc_no,(select val_name from avalute where valute=a.val_acc)as val_name,
  decode( sex,1,'Mr',2,'Ms')||'.' as sex
  from
  pcust_view c,
  account a,
  archost ar 
  where substr(a.acc_no,19,1) in('1','3','4')and  a.bal_cn1 like '3%'and
 c.id=a.kli_id and a.id=ar.acc_id   and ar.ostat<>0 and ar.datdate=:dat and a.kli_id=:custid
